errors.evidence: The pie chart clearly shows five distinct sectors, not four. The sectors are: "Културни различия" (31.0%), "Интеграция на системи" (26.2%), "Загуба на ключови служители" (21.4%), "Финансови затруднения" (16.7%), and "Друго" (4.8%).

The sectors of the pie chart are not arranged in descending order of size. Starting from the largest slice ("Културни различия" at 31.0%) and moving clockwise, the next slice is "Друго" at 4.8%, which breaks any descending order.

The description incorrectly identifies the sector "Друго" as the "fourth and smallest". While it is the smallest sector (4.8%), it is the fifth largest, not the fourth. The fourth largest sector is "Финансови затруднения" at 16.7%. This statement is also contradictory to the initial claim that there are only four sectors in total.
